title: Dreams Are Cheaper Than Flights: Curated World-Model Data Improves Aerial Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.41030v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robot perception is increasingly data driven, yet field data is slow, costly, and sometimes disruptive to collect. Video world models offer a cheaper source: seeded with real frames, they extend a recorded scene into new footage with the deployment's sensor, altitude, and environment. We ask whether such synthetic data matches the utility of real field data and whether detectors trained with it perform in the field. Seeding a 7B-parameter world model with wildlife drone video, we more than double the training set with curated frames. On held-out videos from the same drones, mAP@50--95 rises 4.3\% when these frames are added to real data and 10.3\% when they replace it, and up to 33.5\% on an urban benchmark. Although an expert rejects an estimated 87.5\% of generated clips, the data costs about \$1,100 of GPU time, against more than \$3,200 of field labor alone for a less useful real training set. Synthetic data thus shifts data costs

translated_title: 梦境比飞行更便宜：精选的世界模型数据提升航拍检测性能
translated_abstract: 机器人感知日益依赖数据驱动，然而野外实地数据的采集缓慢、成本高昂，有时还会对环境造成干扰。视频世界模型提供了一种更廉价的替代来源：以真实帧作为种子，它可以将已录制的场景扩展为带有部署时所用传感器、高度和环境特征的新视频。我们探究了这类合成数据能否达到真实野外数据的效用，以及用其训练的检测器在实地场景中的表现。通过以野生动物无人机视频为7B参数世界模型的种子，我们用精选帧将训练集扩大了一倍以上。在同一批无人机的保留测试视频上，将这些帧加入真实数据后mAP@50-95提升4.3%，用其替代真实数据则提升10.3%，在城市基准测试中提升最高达33.5%。尽管专家估计会拒绝约87.5%的生成片段，但该数据仅花费约1,100美元的GPU时间，而一个效用更低的真实训练集仅野外人工成本就超过3,200美元。因此，合成数据改变了数据成本的结构……
tldr: 用7B参数视频世界模型基于真实无人机视频生成精选合成数据，能以约1,100美元GPU时间的低成本显著提升野生动物航拍检测性能（mAP最高提升33.5%），效果优于花费3,200多美元野外人工采集的真实数据。
en_tdlr: Curated synthetic data from a 7B-parameter video world model, seeded with real drone footage, improves aerial wildlife detection by up to 33.5% mAP at roughly one-third the cost of collecting less useful real field data.
